relationships.subject: focused ultrasound
relationships.evidence_quote: A randomized crossover sham-controlled evaluation revealed that the intervention could provide a rapid, clinically meaningful, and durable reduction in chronic pain.

key_findings: Low-intensity transcranial focused ultrasound of the ACC reduced pain by 60% immediately and 33% at day 7 versus 6.6% for sham in 20 patients.
The treatment was well tolerated with no adverse events.
